turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call. Owen found out his zero on his phone, in the middle of your class, and nobody called me first. Tell me why.
"You'll have an answer when you've answered mine. Why was Owen's zero entered before anyone called me? Who decided, and on what basis?"
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.

"Owen admits to nothing, because he did nothing. You've just put a deadline on a confession for something he didn't do, and that's a threat. Withdraw the zero, Hale, and tell me what you actually have."
Those are the only two options. Pick one.

"Neither is an option, and I'm not picking between two things that are both wrong. The zero comes off his record, and you tell me what evidence you have. If it's a document with dates on it, show me."
